player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I tracked the partner of Eve in isolation, assuming that since she was not involved in steps 3 through 7, her partner would remain unchanged. This was a logical error; while Eve's direct interactions stopped, the partners she held (Lola) were swapped with others, and those others eventually swapped with Eve's original partner (Helga) or other people, creating a chain reaction that changed the final state. Next time, I will track the position of **every single person** (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude) through every step simultaneously, rather than focusing only on the target person. I will maintain a full mapping of who is dancing with whom at each step to ensure no indirect changes are missed.
